description: Convert any image to pixel art at a target size (the colour count follows the size). Returns the image; nothing is saved to the library. 1 credit.

image.description: Base64 source image (a data: prefix is stripped automatically)

size.description: Pixel size: 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 192, 256 or 384, or 512 and 1024, drawn on a real 4x grid (128 / 256 art pixels)

name: pixelate_image
